archetypes.name: closure-correctness
archetypes.rationale: Closed, unknown, safe, and exception edges now drive source closure eligibility differently.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the inherited dependency planner and close eligibility paths. Focus on whether satisfied edges are emitted, ignored for writes, and excluded from source-close blockers without weakening unknown-edge fail-closed behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: stale-helper-safety
archetypes.rationale: The new close-stale helper performs live GitHub mutation behind approval-gated prompt prose.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review close-stale argument validation, preflight ordering, warning redaction, dry-run behavior, and comment handling. Confirm failures cannot close issues before validation and that the prompt guidance requires explicit approval before stale closure. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: mapping-fragment-wire
archetypes.rationale: Deferred apply output now feeds prompt-side source-to-combined state accumulation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the SOURCE_TO_COMBINED_JSON_FRAGMENT wire contract and repeated-fragment merge helper. Check stable JSON output, scalar-to-array promotion, deduplication, and compatibility with _parse_source_to_combined. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
